text:
carmen: FYI onboarding ZenithX-9B (ported from a Llama export) — did quick int4 conversion and the summarization suite shows a repeatable dip + some odd failures on inputs with mixed diacritics and ZWJ emoji sequences.
carmen: numbers: fp16 baseline Rouge-L 40.6 -> int4_conv 35.4; BLEU 22.3 -> 18.0; dev PPL 11.9 -> 16.2. consistent across 3 seeds.
josh: ouch. did you run a token-map diff? exporters sometimes change unicode normalization (NFKC vs NFC) or collapse explicit ZWJ sequences which shifts contiguous blocks.
yara: ran token-delta now: ~0.24% token id mismatches, concentrated in U+0300..U+036F and U+200D ranges. example: orig U+0308 -> id 18110, conv U+0308 -> id 18111 (i.e. +1). also emoji ZWJ sequences sometimes change middle token id.
carmen: I also spotted headwise oddness in attention traces: banded phase flips after ~1k tokens. suspect headpack/reshape changed q/k/v packing but rotary arrays left unchanged. that would misapply rotary phases to wrong head vectors.
josh: got a short rotary dump? curious if there's per-head scaling or alternating groups.
yara: snippet from checkpoints:
```text
# zenithx_orig.rotary[:12]
[1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000]
# zenithx_conv.rotary[:12]
[1.000, 1.002, 1.248, 1.249, 1.001, 1.003, 1.250, 1.247, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000]
```
yara: looks like alternating head-group scale applied in conversion (every 2-3 heads), and ordering might be permuted. combo of id-shift + rotary misapply would amplify regressions.
qa-bot: redwood-evals: run 2026-03-30T21:14Z
```text
suite: conversational-summ, emoji-diacritic-subset
models: fp16_zenithx, int4_zenithx_conv
fp16_zenithx: Rouge-L 40.6, BLEU 22.3
int4_zenithx_conv: Rouge-L 35.4, BLEU 18.0
notes: failure cases cluster where reference contains combining marks (accents) or ZWJ-joined emoji; token-delta histogram shows small contiguous bump in combining range; attention heatmaps show per-head phase banding after ~512 tokens.
```
carmen: thanks. I ran a quick `scripts/show_token_block.py --range 0x300-0x370` and confirmed a contiguous +1 offset across a 120-entry sub-block. that explains a small but systematic semantic shift for those characters.
josh: so two likely culprits: (A) tokenizer normalizer / id offset, (B) head-permutation and per-head rotary scaling. can you test A/B separately?
yara: plan: (1) remap.embedding ids in converted checkpoint back to orig ids (embed_remap), reserialize int4 and run eval; (2) permute rotary.freq + q/k/v head slices to match original head indices, reserialize and run eval; (3) both together. will run on dev dedicated tonight.
josh: for the rotary permute make sure we also permute any per-head quant scales or biases that are head-indexed. otherwise kvcache still misindexes.
carmen: good call. also watch tied weights: lm_head and embedding must be remapped together or outputs will be garbage. we had that bug on a previous onboarding.
qa-bot: queued small evals for remap/permute A/B/C (run ids: ev_3601, ev_3602, ev_3603).
nyara: infra-bot: can you snapshot zenithx-conv-int4 for dev runs? need a consistent snapshot for the three experiments.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: snapshot queued: zenithx-conv-int4-remaptest-20260330 (req id: rq_p7e4). ETA ~40m.
josh: experimental hypothesis gating: if remap-only recovers >60% of Rouge-L delta then vocab is primary. if rotary-permute-only recovers major longctx recall and attention heatmap banding resolves, then packing is primary. if both required, it's additive.
carmen: if permutations fix longctx but not ROUGE for diacritic-heavy subset, that points to tokenizer normalizer; we'll prefer remap+emit conversion metadata to avoid re-running tokenizers ecosystem.
yara: small runtime mitigation idea: conversion could emit `meta.head_permutation` and `meta.tokenizer_normalizer` flags so runtime can do on-load remap/permute until we fix conversion tooling. cheaper for urgent customers.
josh: yes, runtime-permute is easiest short-term. but careful: permuting kvcache at runtime has a perf cost (extra mem ops) — measure latency impact on dedicated.
carmen: notes for the run: 1) embed-remap script: scripts/embed_remap.py --mapping mapping.csv --in ckpt.pt --out remapped.pt; 2) rotary-permute script: scripts/permute_heads.py --map head_map.json --in ckpt.pt --out permuted.pt; 3) reserialize int4 with `tools/quantize.py --mode int4 --preserve-vocab-order` when testing.
yara: I'll post the token-delta CSV and head-map once jobs finish. josh/don't forget to add heatmap hooks in eval runner to capture attention norms across 0..1024 tokens.
josh: tagging @yara @infra-bot. please paste quick numbers when runs complete. :coffee:
